newsitem.title: USA: American Management says contracts renewed.
newsitem.headline: American Management says contracts renewed.

text.p: American Management Systems Inc said Wednesday it received contracts to continue its work with the U.S. Navy's fleet modernization program and to perform systems engineering and technical support services for the Puget Sound Naval Shipyard.
The combined contracts are valued at an estimated $152 million over the next five years, the company said in a statement.
The company said its work under the modernization program is valued at an estimated $100 million over five years and respresents a third consecutive contract award since 1981.
The Puget Sound contract is estimated to be worth $52 million over five years. American Management said it is a partner of SRA International Inc in the contract.
American Management said its revenues for 1996 are expected to be approximately $800 million. It reported revenues of $632 million in 1995.
